prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1274; do not mention it.) Never use square brackets or placeholders of any kind.
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This is a recorded statement regarding the collision you were involved in while turning left in Houston, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather keep that off the recording for now, if that's alright. You already have it in the file.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was driving east on a two-lane road and wanted to turn left into a shopping center. There was oncoming traffic, so I waited for a gap. When I started to turn, a car coming from the other direction hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started your turn?

A: I saw headlights, but I thought it was farther away than it was. I should have waited a bit longer.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. My lower back took a hard jolt against the seat belt. By the next morning it was really stiff and sore, and it's still bothering me when I sit or lift anything.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for your back?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to follow up with my doctor. I've scheduled that appointment.

Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle get hurt?

A: No, I was alone in the car.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement before we conclude?

A: Only that the other driver seemed to be going pretty fast. That's all I can say for certain.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
